Questions & answers

Quick answers before we chat.

How do I get started?

Send me a message on WhatsApp with what you need and your deadline. I’ll reply with questions and next steps.

How long does a design take?

It depends on the project. We agree on a timeline together before I start, so there are no surprises.

Can I ask for changes?

Yes. We’ll talk about changes on WhatsApp before work begins so everything is clear for both of us.

What files will I receive?

Final files that are ready to post and print. If you need a specific format, just tell me.

How does payment work?

We agree on the price and payment details on WhatsApp before I start.

Do you create AI-powered designs?

Yes. I create AI-assisted visuals and refine them by hand so they feel original and match your brand.
